cards.name: #10 Extra Heavy
cards.summary: Fine mid-grey canvas weave: a diagonal twill of tiny raised threads shaded light and dark like an emboss (neutral grey, average about #8c8c8c, no hue). It is a texture map more than a colour fill: used as a plain fill it gives a grey canvas surface. The weave is only a few pixels thick, so it reads as fine noise at normal sizes; the tile edges join without a seam. At 100% the twill's main diagonal rises to the right (lower left to upper right) at about 30 to 40 degrees, with a weaker cross-diagonal, the threads about 11 px apart. The same pattern (same pattern ID, identical thumbnail) also ships in Required/Legacy Patterns and More.pat (group 'Legacy Patterns and More/Legacy Patterns/Artists Brushes Canvas') (ps_preset_72, item 36).

plain grey fabric or burlap backdrop
avoid: a plain fill is only grey noise: set a blend mode over colour for the weave to matter

colour work: the tile has no hue
